prompt: Two identical puddles form after rain — one on a calm, cool day and one on a warm, windy day. The second puddle vanishes much faster mainly because warmth and wind speed up what?

options.text: Evaporation of water from the puddle's surface
Condensation of vapour above the puddle
Freezing of the top layer of water

explanation: Warmth gives water molecules more energy to escape, and wind sweeps the vapour away, so evaporation proceeds much faster on a warm, windy day.
